title: Keep an improvement only when the measurement says so, and prove the gate can say no
question_or_target: Implement the decision gate that consumes the B04 paired result and the B07 margin table and emits KEEP, REVERT or INSUFFICIENT-EVIDENCE. The third outcome is the one most implementations omit, and omitting it converts every underpowered run into a KEEP.

implementation.rule: KEEP requires n >= pre_registered_n, a closed interval, interval.lo >= min_effect (higher-is-better primary), and every secondary within its frozen non-inferiority margin. n below pre_registered_n or a missing interval is INSUFFICIENT-EVIDENCE, never KEEP. A powered non-proof is REVERT.

findings.detail: merged commit has no decision-ledger row (KEEP/REVERT/INSUFFICIENT-EVIDENCE missing)

evidence.claim: Synthetic no-op (n=24 identical before/after): outcome=REVERT reason_id=neutral-or-unproven.
Underpowered run (n=4 apparent +30, below pre_registered_n=24): outcome=INSUFFICIENT-EVIDENCE reason_id=underpowered. Not KEEP.
Genuine +10 primary with secondaries inside B07 margins: outcome=KEEP cited_interval=primary_score delta=10.000000 lo=10.000000 hi=10.000000 n=24 level=0.95.
Planted merge chg-ghost with no ledger row: bypass_ids=['chg-ghost'].

tests.requirement: Neutral change -> REVERT, proven on a synthetic no-op change.
Genuine improvement -> KEEP with the interval cited.
A change merged without a gate decision is caught by an audit of the commit range against the decision ledger.

negative_controls.description: A mutant that KEEP's any positive mean accepts the underpowered run; the live gate must not.
Remapping INSUFFICIENT-EVIDENCE to KEEP is the omitted third outcome. Live gate still emits INSUFFICIENT-EVIDENCE.
An audit that always returns ok misses a merge with no ledger row. Live audit flags BYPASS.
